ban_info.description: Returns one ban by ticket number, including identifier, reason, banning user and dates.
ban_info.name: ban_info
ban_info.title: Get ban details

bans_list.description: Lists every ban in the TShock database with ticket number, identifier, reason and dates.
bans_list.name: bans_list
bans_list.title: List bans

broadcast.description: Sends a message to every connected player. Requires TSHOCK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true and the tshock.rest.broadcast permission.

message.description: Message to show in-game. Keep it short and plain text. At most 256 characters.

broadcast.name: broadcast
broadcast.title: Send message to all

events_since.description: Returns server events published after an exclusive cursor: player joins and leaves, chat, commands, deaths, boss kills and region changes. Keep the returned cursor and pass it as 'cursor' on the next call to receive only new events. Omit 'cursor' to read the retained backlog. Event payloads are marked untrusted when a player can influence their text.

cursor.description: Exclusive cursor to resume from. Omit it to start from the oldest retained event.

limit.description: Maximum events to return, between 1 and 500. Defaults to 100.

events_since.name: events_since
events_since.title: Get server events

group_info.description: Returns one group's parent, chat color, granted permissions, negated permissions and total permissions.

group.description: Exact group name, for example 'default' or 'owner'. At most 64 characters.

group_info.name: group_info
group_info.title: Get group details

groups_list.description: Lists every permission group with its parent group and chat color.
groups_list.name: groups_list
groups_list.title: List groups

kick_player.description: Disconnects a player from the server. Requires TSHOCK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true and the tshock.rest.kick permission.

player.description: Exact in-game player name (nickname). At most 64 characters.

reason.description: Optional reason shown to the player. At most 200 characters.

kick_player.name: kick_player
kick_player.title: Kick player

kill_player.description: Kills a player without kicking them. Requires TSHOCK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true and the tshock.rest.kill permission.

from.description: Optional name to attribute the kill to. At most 64 characters.

player.description: Exact in-game player name (nickname). At most 64 characters.

kill_player.name: kill_player
kill_player.title: Kill player

mute_player.description: Mutes a player so their chat is not broadcast. Requires TSHOCK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true and the tshock.rest.mute permission.

player.description: Exact in-game player name (nickname). At most 64 characters.

mute_player.name: mute_player
mute_player.title: Mute player

player_info.description: Returns detailed information for one connected player, including inventory, equipment, buffs, group and mute state. The IP address is redacted unless TSHOCK_MCP_SHOW_IPS=true.

player.description: Exact in-game player name (nickname). At most 64 characters.

player_info.name: player_info
player_info.title: Get player details

players_list.description: Lists connected players with nickname, account name, group, active state, state code and team. IP addresses are never included on this route.
players_list.name: players_list
players_list.title: List players

region_create.description: Creates a protected region in the world. Requires TSHOCK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true. The owner defaults to the server's configured bridge owner; any other owner must be allowed by the server administrator, otherwise the tool returns owner_not_allowed.

height.description: Height in tiles, greater than zero.

name.description: Region name, unique in the world. No slashes. At most 128 characters.

owner.description: Optional region owner allowed by the server policy. At most 128 characters.

width.description: Width in tiles, greater than zero.

x.description: Left tile column of the region, zero or greater.

y.description: Top tile row of the region, zero or greater.

region_create.name: region_create
region_create.title: Create region

region_delete.description: Deletes a region and its protection. This cannot be undone. Requires TSHOCK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true. When the client supports elicitation the operator is asked to confirm; otherwise the call must pass 'confirm: true'.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation for clients that cannot ask the operator. Ignored when elicitation is available.

name.description: Exact region name to delete. At most 128 characters.

region_delete.name: region_delete
region_delete.title: Delete region

region_info.description: Returns one region by its exact name: area, owner, whether building is disabled and which users and groups are allowed. Returns region_not_found when the name does not exist.

name.description: Exact region name, for example 'spawn'. At most 128 characters.

region_info.name: region_info
region_info.title: Get region details

regions_list.description: Lists the regions of the current world with their name, area, owner, protection flags and allowed users and groups. Regions are a bridge feature, so this tool answers bridge_unavailable when the bridge is not configured.
regions_list.name: regions_list
regions_list.title: List regions

reload_config.description: Reloads TShock configuration, permissions and regions. Some changes still need a restart. Requires TSHOCK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true and the tshock.rest.cfg permission.
reload_config.name: reload_config
reload_config.title: Reload configuration

save_world.description: Saves the current world to disk. Requires TSHOCK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true and the tshock.rest.cfg permission.
save_world.name: save_world
save_world.title: Save world

server_motd.description: Returns the message of the day shown to players when they join, if one is configured.
server_motd.name: server_motd
server_motd.title: Get message of the day

server_rules.description: Returns the server rules text shown to players, if one is configured.
server_rules.name: server_rules
server_rules.title: Get server rules

server_status.description: Returns TShock server status: server name, Terraria and TShock versions, port, connected/max players, world name and uptime. Use it as the first health check.
server_status.name: server_status
server_status.title: Get server status

user_info.description: Returns the group and id of one registered account, looked up by name or by numeric id.

user.description: Account name, or numeric id when type is 'id'. At most 64 characters.

user_info.name: user_info
user_info.title: Get account details

users_list.description: Lists every registered TShock account with its numeric id, name and group.
users_list.name: users_list
users_list.title: List accounts

world_info.description: Returns world metadata: name, tile size, current world time, whether it is daytime, blood moon state and invasion size.
world_info.name: world_info
world_info.title: Get world details
